Max India refers to the news report that appeared in the Economic Times of November 04, 2006 of the purported sale of its healthcare subsidiary, Max Healthcare Institute Ltd. This news report is totally baseless and factually incorrect. The group wishes to affirm to all its employees, shareholders, customers and other stakeholders that this news item is seen as mischievous. The company or its officers have neither been in contact with anyone in the ADAG group or for that matter any other party, for the sale of its healthcare business. To the contrary as already reported in our latest investor release, the company has reported robust growth for Max Healthcare and plans are afoot to expand the business both within and beyond the National capital region. We request all stakeholders of the Max Group to put this false news report to rest."
